x_i: The real number in position i of the given sequence.
p_i: the maximum length of a strictly increasing subsequence ending at x_i
q_i: the maximum length of a strictly decreasing subsequence ending at x_i
i: An index of a term in the sequence, between 1 and n^2+1.
j: An index of a term in the sequence later than i.
N: the total number n^2+1 of terms in the given sequence
a_i: the real number at index i in the given sequence
I_i: The maximum length of a strictly increasing subsequence ending at x_i.
D_i: The maximum length of a strictly decreasing subsequence ending at x_i.
n: The positive integer appearing in the theorem statement.
t_r: the final index of a displayed subsequence of length r
r: the length variable used in the definition of p_i
s: the length variable used in the definition of q_i
i_t: the t-th selected index in a strictly increasing subsequence
j_t: the t-th selected index in a strictly decreasing subsequence
x_j: The real number in position j of the given sequence.
I_j: The maximum length of a strictly increasing subsequence ending at x_j.
D_j: The maximum length of a strictly decreasing subsequence ending at x_j.
